register.description: Configures GIC Power Management for Cluster0. Determines whether a core will be routed shared-SPI events that might wake the core.

bitfield.description: GICSS cpu_active input for Core3 of Cluster0Field values (others are reserved):1'b0 - Core is in a software-transparent low power mode, not to receive shared SPIs.1'b1 - Core is active and available for shared SPIs Reset Source: mod_g_rst_n
